issues.text: With the banner now under the product list's app bar, explanation b's outcome is not certain. ProductListScreen watches authProvider in _actions, so every sign-out rebuilds it; a banner it creates without const is rebuilt too, and ref.read in its build then shows the new value. Probe (stage-2 archive, parent watching authProvider): non-const child with ref.read showed 'Not signed in' after signOut; const child kept 'Signed in'. Key (a) is still the only right way.
issues.quote: But `read` subscribes to nothing, so a sign-out from the icon above would leave the banner saying "Signed in".
issues.fix: Explanation b (en): 'But `read` subscribes the banner to nothing: it would switch only if something else happened to rebuild it, and when nothing does, it keeps saying "Signed in".' Same in vi. Or add to the context: 'The banner is its own widget, created with `const`.'
